internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate (50%) and elevated p95 latency (120ms) in the cart service. Initial diagnosis identified an internal error injection as the primary cause. Resource exhaustion was considered but ruled out due to moderate CPU utilization (25%).

Actions taken included disabling the 'cartFailure' flag at 11:20 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.2%). The service was monitored post-recovery to ensure stability.

Key timeline events:
- 11:00:29 Alert received
- 11:20:10 Diagnosis confirmed error injection
- 11:20:15 Flag disabled after approval
- 11:20:15 Recovery verified

This incident highlights the importance of rapid diagnosis and flag management in mitigating service disruptions.
